0022600208.text: The Denver Nuggets (5-3, 9th in the West) visit the Houston Rockets (7-2, 1st in the Southwest), with Denver 1.5 games back in the Northwest after winning its last two, while Houston has lost its most recent game. Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Houston is missing Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not played each other yet this season, and the Nuggets won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 129-93 win over Houston on March 11, 2026.
